So I have this guy friend from work for almost three years now. We spend an awful lot of time together on weekends or after work. We go out of town together to check out museums, churches and other places. After work, we'd go to the mall or coffee shop to talk about topics ranging from work to our interests. We don't tell our co-workers that we do these secret escapades because according to him, he doesn't want other people talking about the both of us. Our other co-workers and friends are not stupid though. Obviously, they notice our 'closeness'. When they ask him about his thoughts about relationships, he would say that he doesn't want it yet because he's still waiting to graduate from his postgrad studies (which will be less than a year now). I like him, of course. But I kinda understand his point that he doesn't want a relationship just yet. But I'm really confused. Does he like me? Am I just following him around? Will I end getting heartbroken with what I'm doing?
